name: I2P Email - Inbound handler v2 (SHADOW, I2P mail only, reply path locked)

nodes.name: One Email
nodes.notes: Started once per email by the inbox poller, so each email has its own execution. One ignored, duplicate or failed email cannot affect another.

nodes.notes: shadow: true means nothing is ever sent to a customer. approved_info must be pasted after sign-off, or no model call is made.

nodes.name: Thread State

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { p_brand: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.brand, p_mailbox: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.mailbox, p_provider: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.provider, p_provider_thread_id: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.provider_thread_id, p_provider_message_id: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.provider_message_id, p_customer_email: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.customer_email, p_customer_name: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.customer_name || null, p_subject: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.subject, p_body: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.text } }}

nodes.notes: ATOMIC CLAIM. One database transaction records the message and claims the conversation. A duplicate message, or a conversation another execution is handling, comes back with claimed = false.

nodes.name: AI Draft
nodes.notes: PAID CALL, one per handled email, capped at 700 output tokens. Failure leaves by the error output and is recorded as failed.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { thread_id: $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id, event_type: $json.outcome === 'escalate' ? 'escalated' : 'draft', direction: 'internal', actor: 'ai', summary: $json.status_reason, body: $json.reply_text, detail: { category: $json.category, confidence: $json.confidence, reasons: $json.reasons, shadow: $json.shadow, in_reply_to: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.provider_message_id } } }}

nodes.name: Finish

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { p_thread_id: $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id, p_provider_message_id: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.provider_message_id, p_status: $('Final Status').first().json.thread_status, p_reason: $('Final Status').first().json.status_reason, p_category: $('Decision Gate').first().json.category, p_submission_id: $('Decision Gate').first().json.matched_order_id } }}

nodes.notes: Applies only while this execution still holds the claim. If the watchdog already failed the conversation, applied is false and no second alert is sent.

nodes.name: Owner Alert

parameters.subject: ={{ '[I2P inbox] ' + ($('Decision Gate').first().json.outcome === 'escalate' || $('Decision Gate').first().json.shadow !== true ? 'Needs you: ' : 'Draft to review: ') + $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.subject }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'From: ' + $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.customer_email + '
Status: ' + $('Finish').first().json.final_status + '
Why: ' + $('Final Status').first().json.status_reason + '

Their email:
' + $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.text + '

Reply text:
' + $('Decision Gate').first().json.reply_text + '

Conversation ID: ' + $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id }}

nodes.notes: OWNER ALERT ONLY. The recipient is fixed to liz@ideatoplan.to. This workflow has no node that emails a customer.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { thread_id: $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id, event_type: 'owner_alert', direction: 'internal', actor: 'system', summary: 'Alert emailed to liz@ideatoplan.to', detail: { gmail_message_id: $json.id } } }}

nodes.name: Not Customer Mail
nodes.notes: Automated mail, newsletters and the automation's own messages end here. Nothing is recorded or answered.

nodes.name: Not Claimed
nodes.notes: Duplicate message, or the conversation is being handled by another execution. This execution does nothing more and alerts nobody.

nodes.name: Late Result
nodes.notes: The conversation was already closed by the watchdog. The decision is in the history; no second alert.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { thread_id: $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id, event_type: 'failed', direction: 'internal', actor: 'system', summary: 'The model call failed. No reply was drafted or sent.', detail: { error: String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || $json.error)) || 'unknown').slice(0, 500) } } }}

={{ { p_thread_id: $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id, p_provider_message_id: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.provider_message_id, p_status: 'failed', p_reason: 'The model call failed. No reply was drafted or sent.' } }}

nodes.name: Failure Alert

parameters.subject: ={{ '[I2P inbox] FAILED: ' + $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.subject }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'An inbound email could not be handled. Nothing was sent to the customer.

From: ' + $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.customer_email + '
Conversation ID: ' + $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id + '

Read and answer it by hand.' }}

nodes.notes: OWNER ALERT ONLY. The recipient is fixed to liz@ideatoplan.to. This workflow has no node that emails a customer.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { thread_id: $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id, event_type: 'alert_failed', direction: 'internal', actor: 'system', summary: 'The owner alert email could not be sent. This conversation still needs you.', detail: { error: String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || $json.error)) || 'unknown').slice(0, 500) } } }}

nodes.name: Claim Model Call

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { p_scope: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.budget_scope, p_max: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.budget_max } }}

nodes.notes: ATOMIC. One database statement counts the call against the limit. Two executions asking at the same moment cannot both get the last call.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $json.allowed === true && $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.dry_run !== true && $('Build AI Request').first().json.too_large !== true }}

nodes.name: Known Conversation

parameters.url: =https://yglmlnfsyzsvozxirlpo.supabase.co/rest/v1/email_threads?mailbox=eq.{{ encodeURIComponent($('Normalize and Filter').first().json.mailbox) }}&provider_thread_id=eq.{{ encodeURIComponent($('Normalize and Filter').first().json.provider_thread_id) }}&select=id&limit=1

nodes.notes: Read only. Is this message part of a conversation that is already on record?

nodes.name: Out Of Scope
nodes.notes: Not a known customer and not clearly about IdeaToPlan. The email stays in the inbox for manual review: no record, no model call, no alert.

nodes.name: Claim Send

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { p_thread_id: $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id, p_in_reply_to: $('Normalize and Filter').first().json.provider_message_id, p_max: $('Mailbox Config').first().json.max_auto_replies } }}

nodes.notes: ATOMIC. One send claim per customer message, for ever. A rerun or a second execution is refused, so nothing is sent twice.

nodes.name: Send Reply
nodes.notes: THE ONLY NODE THAT EMAILS A CUSTOMER. Reached only when shadow is off, sending is on, the address is allowed and the send claim is won. Never retried: a timeout is treated as "may have been sent", not as a reason to send again.

nodes.name: Record Send Event

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { thread_id: $('Thread State').first().json.thread_id, event_type: $json.event_type, direction: 'outbound', actor: 'system', provider_message_id: $json.gmail_message_id, summary: $json.status_reason, body: $json.state === 'sent' ? $('Decision Gate').first().json.reply_text : null, detail: { in_reply_to: $json.in_reply_to, to: $json.to, state: $json.state, gmail_thread_id: $json.gmail_thread_id, error: $json.error } } }}

nodes.notes: Writes the outcome, including the Gmail message id of a sent reply. If this fails, the owner is told the reply WAS sent but not recorded.

nodes.name: Replied
nodes.notes: A routine reply was sent and recorded. No alert is needed.
